text.p: The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) said on Friday a trading halt has been applied to Highlands Gold Ltd shares following the company's request, pending an announcement to the exchange.

Highlands is expected to announce the result of its plans to seek funding arrangements of about A$160 million for the development of the Ramu nickel/cobalt and Frieda-Nena copper and gold projects in Papua New Guinea (PNG).
The capital raising is part of a restructuring of the Highlands group. Under the plan Canadian gold giant Placer Dome Inc would acquire Highlands' 25 percent stake in the Porgera gold mine in PNG.
If Highlands does not get the funding then the restructuring plan would not go ahead. Placer Dome had previously made a 75 cents a share takeover bid for Highlands.
Placer Dome already owns more than 40 percent of Highlands.
Highlands shares were trading three cents lower at 78 cents prior to the trading halt. Earlier the shares hit a high of 83.6 cents.
